Bad and disappointing experience
Mar 2026 • Solo
Bad experience. I am so disappointed about this place. I ordered a salad and a dish with scallops and rice. I got salads after more than 15 minutes. When I finished my salad I waited for the main course to arrive. After 10 minutes sitting and waiting with dirty plates on the table two waitresses asked me if I was waiting for the scallops and rice, I confirmed I was still waiting. After another 10 minutes another waitress came to the table and told me I had to wait another 20 minutes for the scallops. so, basically from the time I placed my first order to the expected delivery time for the scallops 1 hour would pass. At that point I cancelled the remaining order and paid. leaving the place upset, still hungry and very disappointed. I also ordered a fresh apple and pineapple juice, I got it in a fancy glass, but it was full of ice and the amount of juice was so small that I could finish it in one sip , less than 100 cl for sure. Bad service , bad organisation, bad communication. I was at the ramen ichibanken

The restaurant has a wide variety of food options and has decent ambience.

The age dashi was of acceptable quality 8/10 and the highlight was the fried chicken with mentaiko sauce. 8/10 which was billed as the best seller.

The teppanyaki prawns scored a 8/10.

It was devoid of customers for some reason but it may be due to other factors. 

The Fruit Parfait looks fantastic and the taste is outstanding. 8/10

One fault has to be the amount of time spent waiting for the food to be served. There was only 4 tables occupied so a waiting time of 15mins is inexcusable. 5/10

Decent Food, Sloppy Service
Nov 2024 • Couples
Food court restaurant serving decent food and sloppy service. There are better dining choices within mere feet of this down restaurant in an upscale mall food court. 

Ordered tonkatsu and steak with a salad, miso soup, rice, and two orders each of shrimp and vegetable tempura, along with sake. 

Salad arrived quickly. Same followed but needed to be heated and took far too long so we had to ask after it. Steak and one order of tempuras eventually arrived - were working on the others. Miso soup arrived after the steak. Two orders of vegetable tempura randomly arrived. At long last two strips of tonkatsu made it to the table. Dinner was finally served.

All the food items were tasty, though the meats were petit. A few of the veggies were undercooked but not awful. 

All in all, the food was decent but the haphazard, inattentive service outweighed it. We won’t be retuning during our stay in HCMC.
